non_resident_employment_change__quarterl.definition: Published quarterly net change in non-resident employment from the configured MOM final Labour Market Report.
limitations: Employment flow, not population stock.
Excludes non-working non-residents.
Includes workers who may live outside private non-landed housing.
Literature supports the broader non-resident demand mechanism rather than this exact quarterly series.
non_resident_employment_change__quarterl.mechanism: Quarterly non-resident employment change is a timely signal of changes in foreign labour demand that may affect rental demand.
non_resident_employment_change__quarterl.point_in_time_availability: Release date is parsed from the configured final report; archive discovery is not automated.
non_resident_employment_change__quarterl.potential_lag: A timely foreign-labour demand signal that may precede or coincide with rental demand; the exact lag is not estimated.
non_resident_employment_change__quarterl.series_identifier: MOM Labour Market Report 2Q 2026; non-resident employment change

non_resident_population__non_resident_po.definition: Singapore non-resident population stock measured at end-June.
limitations: Annual end-June population stock.
Not all non-residents rent private non-landed homes.
Must not be interpolated to quarterly frequency.
non_resident_population__non_resident_po.mechanism: Growth in the non-resident population may expand the foreign-facing tenant base.
non_resident_population__non_resident_po.point_in_time_availability: Current-vintage annual history; historical release vintages are not exposed by this endpoint.
non_resident_population__non_resident_po.potential_lag: Structural rental-demand measure; effects may appear contemporaneously or over subsequent quarters, but the annual series does not identify a quarterly lag.

private_non_landed_vacancy_rate__rate.definition: Derived share of available private non-landed residential units that are vacant.
limitations: Derived from vacant and available units.
Not an advertised-listings measure.
Executive Condominiums are excluded.
private_non_landed_vacancy_rate__rate.mechanism: Lower vacancy indicates tighter completed housing availability and may support rents.
private_non_landed_vacancy_rate__rate.point_in_time_availability: Current-vintage history; historical release vintages are not exposed by this endpoint.
private_non_landed_vacancy_rate__rate.potential_lag: A contemporaneous tightness measure that may affect rents within the same quarter or with a short lag.
private_non_landed_vacancy_rate__rate.series_identifier: SingStat M400841; Available and Vacant Non-Landed Properties

private_residential_pipeline_supply__tot.definition: Number of planned and under-construction private non-landed residential units in the official development pipeline.
limitations: Pipeline units are not completed available stock.
Project timing and status may be revised.
Executive Condominiums are excluded.
private_residential_pipeline_supply__tot.mechanism: A larger future supply pipeline may moderate sale prices and, after completion, rental pressure.
private_residential_pipeline_supply__tot.point_in_time_availability: Current-vintage history; project status and completion timing may be revised.
private_residential_pipeline_supply__tot.potential_lag: Pipeline changes can lead market outcomes by several quarters or years because units affect usable supply only as projects complete.
private_residential_pipeline_supply__tot.series_identifier: SingStat M400391; Total Non-Landed Properties group

real_gdp_growth__gdp_in_chained_2015_dol.definition: Official year-on-year real GDP growth for Singapore's overall economy in chained 2015 dollars.
limitations: Aggregate GDP is broader than household income, disposable income, or GDP per capita.
Published GDP values may be revised.
real_gdp_growth__gdp_in_chained_2015_dol.mechanism: Stronger real activity may support purchasing capacity and buyer confidence in the sale market.
real_gdp_growth__gdp_in_chained_2015_dol.point_in_time_availability: Current-vintage history; GDP observations may be revised after initial publication.
real_gdp_growth__gdp_in_chained_2015_dol.potential_lag: Broad activity may affect income expectations and purchasing capacity contemporaneously or over subsequent quarters; the lag is not estimated.
real_gdp_growth__gdp_in_chained_2015_dol.series_identifier: SingStat M015631; GDP In Chained (2015) Dollars

three_month_compounded_sora__compounded_.definition: Three-month compounded Singapore Overnight Rate Average reported at month end.
three_month_compounded_sora__compounded_.derivation: last available month-end observation in quarter
limitations: Month-end financing proxy, not an individual mortgage rate.
Quarterly representation uses the final available month-end observation.
An incomplete quarter must be labelled.
three_month_compounded_sora__compounded_.mechanism: Higher short-term financing costs may weaken mortgage affordability and leveraged purchase demand.
three_month_compounded_sora__compounded_.point_in_time_availability: Current-vintage history; the workflow labels a quarterly representation incomplete when the quarter-end month is unavailable.
three_month_compounded_sora__compounded_.potential_lag: Financing conditions may affect affordability and purchase demand over subsequent quarters; the lag is not estimated.
three_month_compounded_sora__compounded_.series_identifier: SingStat M700071; Compounded Singapore Overnight Rate Average (SORA) - 3 Month
three_month_compounded_sora__compounded_.series_label: Compounded Singapore Overnight Rate Average (SORA) - 3 Month (quarter representation)
